sections.title: Morning Shift (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment deployed: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Debrief with guards all clear. Coverage area received. Commencing patrols.
Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear, no issues to report. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a full sweep of the area.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Federal via Wellesley Street.
Federal Street all clear. Welfare check on both 77 Convenience on the corners of Victoria Street. Standing by for security presence.
Commencing sweep on Elliott and Darby Street.
Darby and Elliott Street all clear. Heading towards the Library for welfare check and Lorne Street.
The Library and Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards the office to charge the Ops phone.
Used the restroom and now charging the Ops phone, which is at 11% (photo provided). Standing by at the office.
2 guards have shown up to the office gearing up. Continuing to charge the phone.
Recommencing patrols. Making way towards TK Square for a full sweep and welfare checks on Queen Street stores.
Arrived at TK Square. Full sweep and welfare check on surrounding stores and businesses, all clear, no issues to report. Heading towards Victoria Street.
Arrived at Victoria Street intersection. Welfare check on stores and cathedral all clear, no issues to report. Making way towards Aotea Square for last checkpoint.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep all around, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops phone.
Commencing patrols. Heading towards Elliott Street and Darby Street for sweep. All clear, welfare check on staff and businesses, all clear.
Sweep Federal Street and Wyndham Street all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Queen Street all clear. Welfare checks on stores, no issues to report.
Arrived at Britomart. Commencing full sweep, no issues to report. Welfare check on McDonald's and businesses, all clear.
Sweep on Customs Street East, Gore Street, Fort Street and Fort Lane all clear. Welfare check on stores and businesses, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Response call from Glassons regarding a male vagrant who was yelling at staff and making other members of the public uncomfortable.
Arrived at Glassons Queen Street; POI was already gone. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Queen Street sweep, welfare check on stores, all clear. Making way towards TK Square.
Arrived at TK Square. Commencing full sweep, welfare check on businesses, no issues to report. Heading towards Victoria Street.
Arrived at Victoria Street. Welfare check on stores, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep all around, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by observing foot traffic.

Received a call from Lovisa about a female vagrant that had taken a few items from the store. Guards located her across the road at the bus stop, retrieved the goods and returned them successfully. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Elliott Street / Darby Street sweep all clear.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street all clear.
Heading back to HQ to start the scheduled 30-minute break.
Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Handover complete.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Welfare sweeps from stores going to McDonald's Queen Street, clear, no issues. Heading up Victoria Street for welfare checks.
Victoria Street welfare sweep complete, no issues to report. Heading down to the Cathedral Church for welfare check.
Welfare check on the Cathedral, clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrol down Queen Street heading to Commercial Bay with welfare checks.
Full welfare sweep along lower Queen Street, clear, no issues to report.
Vulcan Lane welfare check clear. Arriving at Commercial Bay.
Full welfare sweep around Commercial Bay clear, no issues to report. Standing by at Commercial Bay catching up on reports and maintaining presence.
Standing down and resuming patrol up High Street heading towards Freyberg / Chancery Square.
High Street, Freyberg and Chancery Square welfare sweep complete, no issues to report; mildly quiet. Heading back to HQ to debrief with Team 2 before sign off.
Team 2 signing off. Team 1 standing by at HQ to charge Ops phone as the battery is low.
No response calls to report. Commencing patrol up Queen Street heading to Lorne.
Welfare sweep through Lorne Street clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check on the Auckland Library clear, no issues. Making way to Aotea Square.
Welfare sweep complete, no issues to report. Making way down to Commercial Bay.
Elliott / Darby Street welfare check complete, no issues to report.
Back onto Queen Street maintaining security presence towards Commercial Bay.
Security presence maintained; welfare checks along Queen Street complete, no issues to report on local stores.
Vulcan Lane welfare check complete, no issues to report. Arriving at Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep on Commercial Bay, Commerce, Tyler Street and Galway complete, no issues to report. Making way back to Gore / Fort Street.
Welfare check on Fort / Gore Street complete, no issues to report. Making way to Chancery via High Street.
High Street welfare check complete, no issues. Arriving at Freyberg.
Freyberg Square full sweep complete, no issues to report.
Chancery Square welfare check complete, no issues to report. Making way to Aotea Square via Lorne / Auckland Library.
Lorne Street welfare check complete, no issues to report. Continuing on patrol en route to the Auckland Library.
Walkthrough the Auckland Library, clear, no issues to report. Heading over to Aotea.
Welfare sweep on Aotea, clear, no issues. Heading up to Victoria Street.
Full welfare sweep on Victoria Street, clear, no issues found to report.
Wyndham Street welfare check clear, no issues to report.
Welfare checks complete. Standing by for response calls and maintaining security presence along Queen Street until 22:00.
Security presence maintained; no response calls, no issues found to report. Foot traffic mildly quiet. Making way back to HQ for break.
Afternoon shift complete, no issues to handover to night shift. Equipment handover complete. Signing off.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Welfare check on Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store. McDonald's have a couple that they are observing and will call us if they need assistance. Standing by for security presence.
Heading back to the office to charge the Ops phone, it's on 8%.
Received a call from Hasi. Heading down.
Been given food to distribute to fellow guards and vagrants in need of a hot meal, sponsored by ASG. Standing by upstairs to continue charging Ops phone.
Received a call from QFTAV on Wyndham Street for assistance with an intoxicated male being aggressive. Heading to assist.

Received a call back from QFTAV. Have a description of the male and the direction he went: large built, local, blue pants, grey hoodie and backpack. Last seen heading towards Queen Street. Continuing patrol down towards Britomart to see if the POI can be spotted.
Arrived at Britomart. Welfare check on Q Convenience Store, no issues. Commencing sweep of the area to check for the POI.
Britomart McDonald's, TK Square and Commercial Bay all clear, no issues. No sign of the POI. Heading towards Fort Street.
Fort Lane, Fort Street, Pocket Park, Jo&Joes, White Lady's and Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues. Heading towards Gore Street.
Chargrill all clear. Auckland Harbour Suites all clear. Gave food to security of Auckland Harbour and The Mermaid. Standing by for security presence.
High Street all clear. Heading to Avani Metropolis.
Gave food to guard at Metropolis. Heading towards Chancery Square.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading up towards Victoria Street to hand food to security.
Gave food to First Security since ASG security went to the restroom. They said they will give the food to him.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's about an intoxicated male sleeping and refusing to leave. Heading there now.
Received a call back. The male has left and is heading towards a taxi. Heading through Albert towards Wyndham Street.
Albert Street all clear. Checking up on Q Convenience.
All clear. Heading towards Mills Lane.
Mills Lane all clear. Heading down the alleyway where New World Queen St is on.
Britomart McDonald's all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Heading back up towards Aotea Square.
Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing sweep.
All clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
The Library area and Lorne Street all clear. Heading out to give food on Queen Street.
Gave food out to heavy sleepers and 2 drunk people on Queen Street. At Britomart checking around for any more heavy sleepers.
Given out quite a few but still some left. Heading back to the office for break.
Standing by to charge the Ops phone.
Queen St McDonald's all clear, 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading towards Elliott Street.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's asking for assistance with a male vagrant sleeping in store. Heading there now.
Arrived and the male had already left. Standing by for security presence.
At HQ standing by for shift changeover.
